mapper.select: SELECT p.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta), 0) AS reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_code = p.execution_code AND r.routing_node_id = p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_code = #{executionCode} GROUP BY p.routing_node_id

SELECT r.id AS reportId, r.quantity_delta + COALESCE(SUM(a.quantity_delta), 0) AS effectiveQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_code = e.execution_code LEFT JOIN mes_production_report a ON a.reference_report_id = r.id AND a.execution_code = e.execution_code AND a.routing_node_id = r.routing_node_id WHERE e.execution_code = #{executionCode} AND r.id = #{reportId} GROUP BY r.id, r.quantity_delta

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM mes_production_report r WHERE r.execution_code = #{executionCode} AND r.record_type = 'REPORT' AND r.quantity_delta + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(a.quantity_delta) FROM mes_production_report a WHERE a.reference_report_id = r.id AND a.execution_code = r.execution_code AND a.routing_node_id = r.routing_node_id ), 0) != 0

SELECT e.execution_code AS executionCode,e.workorder_id AS workorderId,e.routing_id AS routingId, e.target_qty AS targetQty,p.path_status AS pathStatus, CASE WHEN e.routing_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) END AS lastNodeReportedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.output_qty) FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code WHERE f.execution_code=e.execution_code AND f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted}),0) AS productionInputQty FROM mes_production_execution e LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path p ON p.execution_code=e.execution_code LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path_node n ON n.execution_code=e.execution_code AND n.sequence_no=(SELECT MAX(last.sequence_no) FROM mes_execution_path_node last WHERE last.execution_code=e.execution_code) LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_code=e.execution_code AND r.routing_node_id=n.routing_node_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY e.id,e.workorder_id,e.routing_id,e.target_qty,p.path_status ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.sql: FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code WHERE f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS reservedQty AND f.execution_code=#{executionCode}
SELECT f.execution_code AS executionCode,COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS reservedQty AND f.execution_code IN #{id} GROUP BY f.execution_code

SELECT p.execution_code executionCode,p.routing_node_id routingNodeId,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_code=p.execution_code AND r.routing_node_id=p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_code IN #{id} GROUP BY p.execution_code,p.routing_node_id
